name: Lumen Keynote
tagline: A complete 14-slide monochrome keynote with huge Montserrat typography, embedded source fonts and deliberate gray-level hierarchy.

palette.description: Exact source near-black background and near-white display text, with distinct warm gray levels for secondary meaning, fine rules and chapter numerals; blue is restricted to the original browser-style progress indicator.

typography.style: Exact source static WOFF 400 and 700 faces embedded for both families, with source CSS weight requests (including 500/600/900 matching) retained. Oversized 114–375 px display frames, tightly measured negative letter spacing and 13.5 px counters on a 1280 × 720 canvas. Montserrat OFL and Open Sans Apache 2.0 license texts are embedded.

best_for: Low-density product launches, software keynotes, single-message leadership talks and founder narratives that use very large typography, focused comparison, metrics, roadmaps and pricing.
avoid_for: Dense research reports, complex data tables, illustrated classroom materials or presentations that need many paragraphs on each slide.

source_inspiration.name: Lumen by the Slides official template team
source_inspiration.notes: Complete fourteen-page reconstruction of the public source with native HTML text and inline SVG geometry, preserving the source 1280×720 positions, all content, gray hierarchy, original Montserrat/Open Sans static font files, exact CSS size/weight/line-height/letter-spacing and slide sequence. Font licenses are embedded. One decorative U+2192 symbol on slide 9 is independently traced as native SVG in its original frame and gray, since the original WOFFs omit it and cross-engine fallback produces a different solid-arrow glyph; all other text and typography remain native and unchanged. Source page variables are resolved and a minimal independent runtime supplies controls, guarded keyboard navigation, hash state, counters and progress. No full-slide screenshots, image assets, source site runtime or network dependencies are included.
